title.zh: 经归并的推广：归并恰在它归并之处推广，正确恰在世界经归并同去之处；结构与变化是同一个归并；训练经数据选择，拟合在数据之外正确恰当类在那里决定；习得链与连接主义模型是其实例
title.en: Generalization through a lumping: a lumping generalizes exactly where it lumps and is right exactly where the world goes alike across it; structure and change are one lumping; training selects through the data, and a fit is right beyond the data exactly where the class determines it; the acquisition chain and the connectionist models are instances

claim.zh: 设 C 是函数 I → V 的类，D 是数据（输入上的命题），x 是输入。在 C 之中数据固定 x 处之值（Determines C D x），指 C 中在 D 上一致的两个成员在 x 取同一值；g 经归并 π : I → K 同去（Lumped π g），指 π 相同的输入取同一值；C 在 x 处于数据之外自由（Free C D x），指每个成员在 D 上的值都能与每个成员在 x 的值组合。不加前提：某个观察输入与 x 被 π 归并时，经 π 同去的函数之类在 x 由数据决定（lumped_determines）；有两个不同的值、数据是列表、K 的相等可判定时，这恰当某个观察输入与 x 被归并（determines_lumped_iff）。经 π 同去、在 D 上拟合世界 f 的成员 g，在与观察输入 d 归并的 x 处正确，恰当 f d = f x（lumped_right_iff）；f 本身经 π 同去时正确（lumped_world_right）。自由的类在 x 由数据决定，恰当其成员在 x 都相同（free_determines_iff）；一切函数之类在每个未观察的输入处自由（every_free），有两个值时数据在那里不决定任何东西（every_determines_nothing）。变化：P 是过程、π 是配置的投影时，经 π 相同者同去（P66 的 GoAlike），恰当每两个经 π 相同的配置以每个动作同去（GoAlikeAt、goAlike_iff_at）；P 确定、在 s₀ 观察到 a 的结果 u₀ 时，经 π 读的结果转移到 s 处 a 的每一步，恰当 s₀ 与 s 经 π 以 a 同去（transfer_right_iff）；确定律 next 经 π 同去，恰当 π ∘ next 经 π 同去（goAlike_iff_lumped）。训练：经关系 alike 的选择（Training.Through）把 alike 的候选选得相同；P64 的经识选择恰是经“直到 t 识得相同”的选择（Training.web_selectsThrough_iff，定义上相同）；由数据上的值算出的损失以及由它作出的每个选择经“在数据上一致”选择（Training.loss_through）；在 x 自由的类中，经数据的每个选择对每个被选成员与每个成员在 x 的值，都有一个被选成员与前者在数据上一致而在 x 取该值（Training.unselected_beyond_data）；C 中每个在数据上与 C 中世界一致的成员在 x 都取世界之值，恰当 Determines C D x（Training.fit_right_iff）。见证：Shift（输入为位置与内容，归并读内容，数据只在一个位置）中归并决定未试的输入（Shift.determines），一切函数之类不决定（Shift.every_nothing），世界各位置相同时推广正确（Shift.right_same），不同时错误（Shift.wrong_both）。外围（LearningCorrespondence，Lean 4.30.0-rc2 与 Mathlib）：在原子效果可分辨的一致律族中，CompositionalAcquisition 的三次接触决定每个表达式（uniform_determines，习得代码的精确性逐例重证，acquire_exact），容许其非一致律时在新表达式处不决定（nonuniform_not_determined）；固定权重下网络的发展是其步的轨道（develop_orbit）；Hebb 式发展是 P66 的 adaptive 系统（hebbian、hebbian_determined），活动恰在权重对其步不造成差别之处有自己的律（hebbian_activity_law_iff），三单元记忆中权重造成差别（weights_matter），所以活动单独没有律（hebbian_no_activity_law）；更新路线下的网络又是 adaptive 系统，路线是规则（updating、updating_determined），网络恰在路线不造成差别之处有自己的律（updating_network_law_iff），起始网络与第一个任务上两条路线不同（route_matters），所以网络单独没有律（updating_no_network_law）；回应路线恰在任务失败处学习（responsive_kept、responsive_learns）。
claim.en: Let C be a class of functions I → V, D the data (a proposition on inputs) and x an input. Within C the data fix the value at x (Determines C D x) when two members of C agreeing on D take one value at x; g goes alike across a lumping π : I → K (Lumped π g) when inputs alike under π take one value; C is free at x beyond the data (Free C D x) when every member's values on D combine with every member's value at x. With no premise: where an observed input is lumped with x by π, the class of functions going alike across π is determined at x by the data (lumped_determines); given two values, data in a list and decided equality on K, this holds exactly where some observed input is lumped with x (determines_lumped_iff). A member g going alike across π and fitting the world f on D is right at an x lumped with an observed d exactly where f d = f x (lumped_right_iff), and is right where f itself goes alike across π (lumped_world_right). A free class is determined at x by the data exactly where its members all agree at x (free_determines_iff); the class of every function is free at every input not observed (every_free), and with two values the data determine nothing there (every_determines_nothing). Change: for a process P and a projection π of configurations, going alike under π (P66's GoAlike) is going alike by every move at every two configurations alike under π (GoAlikeAt, goAlike_iff_at); where P is determined and the outcome u₀ of a at s₀ is observed, the outcome read through π transfers to every step of a from s exactly where s₀ and s go alike under π by a (transfer_right_iff); a determined law next goes alike under π exactly where π ∘ next goes alike across π (goAlike_iff_lumped). Training: a selection through a relation alike (Training.Through) selects alike candidates alike; P64's selection through registration is exactly a selection through registering alike up to t (Training.web_selectsThrough_iff, by definition); a loss computed from the values on the data, and every choice made from it, select through agreeing on the data (Training.loss_through); within a class free at x, every selection through the data has, for every selected member and every member's value at x, a selected member agreeing with the first on the data and taking that value at x (Training.unselected_beyond_data); every member of C agreeing on the data with a world in C takes the world's value at x exactly where Determines C D x (Training.fit_right_iff). Witness: in Shift (inputs a position and a content, the lumping reading the content, data at one position only) the lumping determines the untried input (Shift.determines), the class of every function does not (Shift.every_nothing), and the generalization is right where the world is the same at every position (Shift.right_same) and wrong where it differs (Shift.wrong_both). Periphery (LearningCorrespondence, Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and Mathlib): within the uniform law family with distinguishable primitive effects the three encounters of CompositionalAcquisition determine every expression (uniform_determines, the exactness of the acquired code re-proved case by case, acquire_exact), and admitting its nonuniform law they determine nothing at the novel expression (nonuniform_not_determined); a network's development under fixed weights is the orbit of its step (develop_orbit); Hebbian development is P66's adaptive system (hebbian, hebbian_determined), activity having a law of its own exactly where the weights make no difference to its step (hebbian_activity_law_iff), and in the three-unit memory they do (weights_matter), so activity alone has no law (hebbian_no_activity_law); the network under a route of updating is again an adaptive system with the route as the rule (updating, updating_determined), having a law of its own exactly where the route makes no difference (updating_network_law_iff), and at the starting network and first task the two routes differ (route_matters), so the network alone has no law (updating_no_network_law); the responsive route learns exactly where the task fails (responsive_kept, responsive_learns).

hypotheses.zh: 核心部分不加公理；类 C、数据 D、归并 π 与选择由学习之外给出；determines_lumped_iff 另设两个不同的值、列表数据与 K 上可判定的相等，every_free 设 I 上可判定的相等。
hypotheses.en: The core part adds no axiom; the class C, the data D, the lumping π and the selection are supplied from outside the learning; determines_lumped_iff further assumes two different values, data in a list and decided equality on K, and every_free decided equality on I.

hypotheses.zh: 外围部分以 Lean 4.30.0-rc2 与 Mathlib 检查：习得部分的声明公理报告为空；用实数的网络部分的声明报告 Mathlib 的标准公理（propext、Classical.choice、Quot.sound），逐项列于桥接回执。语法、探针、任务、剖面、常数与路线取自既有模块，保持其原有范围。
hypotheses.en: The periphery is checked with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and Mathlib: the acquisition declarations have empty axiom reports; the network declarations, which use real numbers, report Mathlib's standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), listed one by one in the bridge receipt. Grammar, probes, tasks, profiles, constants and routes are taken from the earlier modules with their earlier scope.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-12：“我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模”。依 Ren 的读法，理是对结构与变化之规律的建模；AI 把对结构的建模读作一个归并（Lumped），把对变化的建模读作步骤经它同去的归并（GoAlike），goAlike_iff_lumped 说两者是同一个概念。它取代 AI 在 P49 中的读法“对识负责的模型”；按 Ren 的读法，模型仍只经识被检验。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：关于何者无关的模型何时正确，就是世界何时经它所归并者同去；自然的一致性不是前提而是这一局部条件；古德曼的新谜是选哪个归并；every_determines_nothing 是“没有免费的午餐”的有限、确定性形式；对受训网络，类是训练所能达到的，推广来自结构、起点与更新所施加的归并（位置间共享、不变性、组合），不来自损失。
correspondence.en: Ren, 12 October 2026: “我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模”. On Ren's reading 理 is the modeling of the laws of structure and of change; the AI reads a model of structure as a lumping (Lumped) and a model of change as a lumping the step goes alike across (GoAlike), and goAlike_iff_lumped says the two are one notion. This replaces the AI's reading in P49, “a model answerable to registration”; on Ren's reading a model is still tested only through registration. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): when a model of what is irrelevant is right is when the world goes alike across what it lumps; the uniformity of nature is not a premise but that local condition; Goodman's new riddle is which lumping; every_determines_nothing is a finite, determined form of “no free lunch”; for a trained network the class is what training can reach, and generalization comes from the lumping that architecture, starting points and updates impose (sharing across positions, invariance, composition), not from the loss.

detail.zh: 复用 GoAlike、carries_law_iff、adaptive、adaptive_determined、adaptive_state_law_iff、Run.not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike。增量是把相同者同去读作一个归并：结构与变化是同一个归并（goAlike_iff_lumped），结果转移恰在步骤同去之处（transfer_right_iff）；外围的 Hebb 式发展与更新路线是 adaptive 的实例。
detail.en: Reuses GoAlike, carries_law_iff, adaptive, adaptive_determined, adaptive_state_law_iff and Run.not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike. The delta reads going alike as a lumping: structure and change are one lumping (goAlike_iff_lumped), and an outcome transfers exactly where the step goes alike (transfer_right_iff); the periphery's Hebbian development and route of updating are instances of adaptive.

output.zh: 投影恰在相同者同去时承载确定的规律；改变自身规则的系统的状态恰在规则不造成差别之处有自己的规律。
output.en: A projection carries a determined law exactly where configurations alike go alike; a system changing its own rule has a state law exactly where the rule makes no difference.

input.zh: 归并的推广何时正确；结构与变化的同一；网络与更新路线的规律。
input.en: When a lumping's generalization is right; structure and change as one; the laws of networks and routes of updating.

conditions.zh: 不加前提；transfer_right_iff 设过程确定。
conditions.en: No premise; transfer_right_iff assumes the process determined.

detail.zh: 复用 Web.SelectsThrough 与 Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo：经识的选择是经“识得相同”的选择（Training.web_selectsThrough_iff）。增量是把选择移到训练上：损失经数据选择，数据之外的值与类同样自由。
detail.en: Reuses Web.SelectsThrough and Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo: selection through registration is selection through registering alike (Training.web_selectsThrough_iff). The delta carries selection over to training: a loss selects through the data, and values beyond the data stay as free as the class leaves them.

output.zh: 两段历史被每个经识的选择选得相同，恰当选择者把它们识得相同。
output.en: Two histories are selected alike by every selection through registration exactly when the selector registers them alike.

input.zh: 训练作为经数据的选择；拟合在数据之外何时正确。
input.en: Training as selection through the data; when a fit is right beyond the data.

detail.zh: 那里实验需要一个关于何者无关的模型；这里说这样的模型何时正确：恰在世界经它所归并者同去之处。
detail.en: There experiment needs a model of what is irrelevant; here, when such a model is right: exactly where the world goes alike across what it lumps.

detail.zh: 那里从记录选出假设的学习何时静止；这里一个类或归并在数据之外决定什么。
detail.en: There, when learning that selects a hypothesis from the record comes to rest; here, what a class or lumping determines beyond the data.

detail.zh: 那里理读作对识负责的模型（AI 的读法），这里依 Ren 读作对结构与变化之规律的建模；模型只经识被检验仍成立。
detail.en: There 理 was read as a model answerable to registration (the AI's reading); here, on Ren's reading, as the modeling of the laws of structure and change; that a model is tested only through registration still holds.

detail.zh: 那里更新程序经实际执行重建；这里更新路线是网络之上的规则，网络单独没有律之处恰是路线造成差别之处。
detail.en: There an updating procedure is reconstructed through actual performance; here the route of updating is the rule above the network, and the network alone has no law exactly where the route makes a difference.

detail.zh: 归并错误时推广错误：Shift 中世界在各位置不同时，经内容归并、在数据上拟合世界的函数在未试的位置错（Shift.wrong_both）；一切函数之类在未试之处不决定任何东西（every_determines_nothing）。
detail.en: A wrong lumping generalizes wrongly: in Shift, where the world differs across positions, a function lumped by content and fitting the world on the data is wrong at the untried position (Shift.wrong_both); the class of every function determines nothing at an untried input (every_determines_nothing).

limitations.zh: 类、数据与归并是给出的；一个实际形成或网络持有或能达到哪个类、施加哪个归并、其与世界的对应，不推出；优化的动力学、隐式偏置、概率的推广界（PAC、VC 维）没有陈述；外围的网络是三单元的小模型，不是现代深度网络；goAlike_iff_lumped 近于定义展开，内容在于它使 Ren 的理有一个形式所指；外围实例是既有结果的重读与数值见证，增量是连接；读法除理（Ren 的）之外是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: The class, the data and the lumping are supplied; which class an actual formation or network holds or can reach, which lumping it imposes and its correspondence to the world are not derived; optimization dynamics, implicit bias and probabilistic generalization bounds (PAC, VC dimension) are not stated; the periphery's networks are three-unit models, not modern deep networks; goAlike_iff_lumped is near-definitional, its content being that it gives Ren's 理 a formal referent; the periphery instances re-read earlier results and give numerical witnesses, the delta being the connection; the readings other than 理 (Ren's) are the AI's, pending Ren; contains no ethical predicate.

next_delta.zh: 实际网络的结构施加哪个归并（位置间共享、不变性）的外围实例；不确定过程上的推广；与 P69 的 Alike 及 P70 的描述所保留与失去者的实例定理；Ren 对 AI 关于理的形式读法的判断。
next_delta.en: Periphery instances of the lumping an actual architecture imposes (sharing across positions, invariance); generalization over undetermined processes; instance theorems with P69's Alike and P70's account of what a description keeps and loses; Ren's judgment on the AI's formal reading of 理.
